invariants.rationale: If passwordMode is enabled or there is no selection, the clipboard is not set in copy() and original clipboard content remains unchanged.
copy() assumes clipboard is present to set contents if the main condition holds; clipboard is likely non-null as per design.
text must be non-null for text.substring to be called safely if hasSelection && !passwordMode.
cursor is used as a bound in substring(), so must be non-negative for correct operation.
selectionStart is also used as a bound in substring(), so must be non-negative for correct operation.
